review.limit: PR/comments and existing run metadata only; no fresh review collection or workflow job reads.

actualReviewerMetadata.limit: Actual saved metadata, not a reviewer runtime/use test. New absolute expiry precision is not inferred from a minute-resolution display.

assessment.condition: If review needs access beyond the retained expiry, Docker supplies a supported secure update route through the existing accepted review channel; worker then arranges bounded renewal and verifies saved bounds/use. No overlapping orphan key or public credential.

browserBoundary: The current metadata observation succeeds. Browser connection then becomes unavailable; no fresh private-form/edit-route or mailbox inspection is claimed. Native application control remains available.
unblock: Docker maintainers approve/run workflows and review/merge/import; worker verifies actual public/native installation. Longer reviewer access separately needs the supported secure delivery route before renewal.
